consumer: law_set dataset governance chain (gate + bundle export + distribution consumers)
title: Evorule Law entry (law_set dataset payload)
description: Law entry payload contract for law_set datasets. A law states an equation identity (equation-always-true semantics: the equation separator is compiled to an equality comparison downstream); condition/then decision semantics belong to rule_set entries and are structurally excluded here. Seven semantic elements: formula / symbols / si_units / domain / solvable / derivation / tier. Entry-level admission (machine gate) additionally requires all seven elements present and rejects bare equation separators (a separator with an empty side).
